name: grip-dynamometer-reveal
description: Hydraulic hand dynamometer (Jamar-style) anatomy figure and reveal films for Optimal Health, Barrie.

scripts.film: node motion/build.mjs --duration 12 --ratio 16:9 --out motion-16x9.html && node motion/build.mjs --duration 12 --ratio 9:16 --out motion-9x16.html
scripts.check: node object/scan-apart.mjs -35 15 && node object/scan-apart.mjs 0 5 && node object/scan-apart.mjs 140 20 && node object/scan-apart.mjs 90 -20 && node object/scan-apart.mjs -20 70 && node motion/scan.mjs motion/motion-16x9.html && node motion/scan.mjs motion/motion-9x16.html
scripts.qa: node scripts/camera-check.mjs motion/motion-16x9.html motion/motion-9x16.html && node scripts/caption-check.mjs motion/motion-16x9.html out/qa16 fine && python3 scripts/caption-check.py out/qa16 0-1.82,10.42-12 && node scripts/caption-check.mjs motion/motion-9x16.html out/qa9 fine && python3 scripts/caption-check.py out/qa9 0-1.82,10.42-12
